verdict.rationale: Galileo is an LLM observability and tracing platform, so masking or redacting sensitive data before it reaches traces is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents redaction, masking, PII scrubbing or pre-storage filtering of trace data. The docs only describe capturing every session, trace and span, which is general logging and says nothing about redaction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
